build_header_only_library: build a header-only library by copying include directory to install location without compilation
install_header_only_headers: install header-only library headers by copying source include directory to the install destination
configure_header_only_builder: configure a HeaderOnlyBuilder instance which requires no setup for header-only libraries
review_HeaderOnlyBuilder_install: review the HeaderOnlyBuilder install method that copies headers and handles missing include directories
refactor_HeaderOnlyBuilder_include_subdi: refactor the HeaderOnlyBuilder to customize the include_subdir build option for non-standard header paths
